technique_name: Write a short story based on the article.
description: Kim had been feeling overwhelmed and exhausted. Life felt like it was moving too fast, and she couldn't keep up. But she kept pushing herself, too afraid to slow down and make time for herself. But then she heard about the survey results — 90% of participants agreed that self-care was important for overall health and well-being. It was the wake-up call that Kim needed to start taking care of herself. She began setting aside time for walks, meditation, and other activities that made her happy. Fi
example: In a recent survey, 90% of participants indicated that self-care is important for their overall health and well-being.
